items.title: Albert Glenny Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: That's just my friend there. ... My father, that's my good friend.

ctx.x: That's he. You, she. 된 stuff Oh, you there? What's your John Robichaud? The violin, the left hand violin? Yes. He dressed so well. Oh, I showed him my friend. Imagine a musician in town, you can tell. That's just my friend there. My father, that's my good friend. Actually, everyone who worked, they know me. I could do nothing. What kind of music they play? John Robichaud's band. What kind of music they play? Oh, they had a band. Up to the minute. He was a musician too. That's what I tell them. I play with the…
Is the Big Gaspar still around as they live near here? Yeah, but he don't play anymore. He's very sick. About music. About music.
